text.text: Type /prusaconnect and a command. Only you see the answers, unless a command says it posts.

*Printers (in #bots)*
`/prusaconnect status`  Tick printers and see what they are doing, or post it in #bots.
`/prusaconnect jobs`  Tick printers and see their last prints.
`/prusaconnect snap`  Tick printers and post a picture from each one's camera in #bots. Also: snapshot, cam, camera.

*Your account on the printer server*
`/prusaconnect signup`  Make your account (denhac members with 3D Printer User).
`/prusaconnect password`  Set a new password on your account.
`/prusaconnect whoami`  What the bot knows about you.
`/prusaconnect link [code]`  Link your Slack user to an account you already have.

*Admins*
`/prusaconnect suspend [@user|username|member code] [reason]`  Turn an account off until an admin lifts it. Alone, lists the suspensions.
`/prusaconnect unsuspend <@user|username|member code>`  Lift a suspension.
`/prusaconnect lookup <@user|username|member code>`  Which member code, Slack user and account belong together.
`/prusaconnect admin <@user|username|member code>`  Make a member's account an admin.
`/prusaconnect unadmin <@user|username|member code>`  Take admin from an account the bot made an admin.

*This bot*
`/prusaconnect help`  This list.
`/prusaconnect bot`  How the bot itself is doing.
